rootCause: Existing verified continuity gates bot and persona identity/version and reliably keeps the same playful exchange.
The quantity-continuation heuristic only checked a shared unit and textual references; it neither identified a unique object nor calculated an adjacent change.
The existing three-turn test used a predetermined correct second reply and checked continuity/prompt text, not the arithmetic of a generated candidate.
Ordinary social output has no quantity validator; this patch deliberately adds no validator, output rewrite or extra social model request.

changes.description: Private adjacent-turn cue derives one literal quantity/object from verified previous speech and one explicit current addition/deduction. Requires the existing verified bit continuation, same bot target, same unit and same object or an elliptical same-bit reference. Emits a local arithmetic reference only into the existing generation prompt.

Original case20 first reply and current deduction yield 3 - 2 = 1; generic leave-token/coffee and Arabic/Chinese counts; old proposals, changed objects/units/owners, ordinary new experiences, multi-operation, uncertain/fractional/negative-result changes and mismatched persona/bot abstain. Candidate joke text remains unchanged.

boundaries: No contract, persistence schema, social ledger, output guard or additional model request.

Source quantities must be unique literal counts at the beginning of the previous reply, optionally after a short acknowledgement. Proposals, alternatives, quoted third-party content and uncertain ownership abstain.
Only nonnegative simple integer results are anchored; unsupported forms simply keep the existing prompt.
A cue is not a verdict that every debt question or exaggeration is an arithmetic error, and is not proof of real payment or accepted agreement.
No live model replay, server action, dist build or test-build emission was performed.
